day_shape: 71 items: Houthis advance to Bab el-Mandeb and Perim Island with Yemeni forces withdrawing, IDF kills Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander and destroys 5km Hezbollah tunnel complex at Ali Taher, OFAC publishes Iran GLs CC/DD, Pezeshkian pitches $10bn BRICS reinsurance vehicle, Anthropic reports Iran-linked AI misuse against US Navy.

threads.label: Houthi advance toward Bab el-Mandeb
threads.summary: Houthi forces advanced to Dhubab and entered Perim Island as Yemeni government forces withdrew, with regime channels claiming control of the Hanish islands and liberation of six areas across Taiz and al-Hudaydah. Jerusalem Post cited an Al Akbar report that Netanyahu signalled Israel could join a broader regional campaign against the Houthis.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed killing Muhammad Yazouri, commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, along with two other operatives, and separately eliminated Hamas sniper cell head Moamen Abu Labda. The IDF also released footage of the destruction of a 5+ km Hezbollah tunnel complex under the Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, said to have been built with Iranian funding.

threads.label: Pezeshkian at BRICS pushes de-dollarisation
threads.summary: Pezeshkian proposed a joint BRICS reinsurance company capitalised at $10 billion and called for expanded use of national currencies in intra-BRICS trade, and met Indian PM Modi on the summit sidelines. Foreign Minister Araghchi said BRICS members agree on strengthening national currencies while a single currency remains under review.

threads.label: US sanctions machinery: OFAC licences
threads.summary: OFAC published two Iran-related general licences (GLs CC and DD) in the Federal Register, alongside four Venezuela sanctions general licences previously issued on its website. Three UK parliamentary questions from James McMurdock were tabled to the FCDO on the effectiveness of Iran sanctions referenced in the 8 September Written Ministerial Statement.

threads.label: Iran-linked AI activity against US Navy
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported an Anthropic study finding Iran-linked actors used AI to target US naval forces and profile Israeli and Jewish diaspora organisations. Defa Press reproduced the Wall Street Journal account, framing it as an American company's claim rather than fact.

threads.label: Iran attacks IAEA, floats Gulf meeting
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Baghaei accused the IAEA of being turned into a tool for justifying military aggression against Iran, and announced planning for a meeting of Persian Gulf littoral states in Oman on Monday. Defa Press also reported completion of three Iranian judicial files on alleged US 'war crimes' in Hormozgan.

threads.label: Conservative rift over Pezeshkian
threads.summary: Iran International reported that a hardline lawmaker's attempt to raise Pezeshkian's removal has exposed divisions within the conservative camp rather than a hardliner-moderate split. Regime-aligned voices, including an IRGC cultural deputy and Tehran's Friday prayer leader, warned of enemy efforts to undermine national resilience and stability.

events.title_en: Ansarallah took control of all islands in the Bab al-Mandab Strait
events.summary_en: Ansarallah took control of all islands in the Bab al-Mandab Strait. According to the French news agency, citing an unnamed Yemeni military official, the Ansarallah movement has continued its military advance along Yemen's coasts and seized the islands of Hanish Major and Hanish Minor in the Bab al-Mandab Strait in the Red Sea. According to the official, Ansarallah forces now control all islands in this strait. The Hanish Islands are located near this strait and have strategic significance.
